title: Telecom Statement 1.0: common definitions
description: The envelope and shared types of every telecom statement. A statement is produced by a Telecom Information Provider (TIP, the operator) for a Telecom Information User (TIU, a regulated fintech) under a customer's consent, delivered through a consent manager that cannot read it. Every object is closed (additionalProperties false); operator-specific data goes only in `extensions`.

envelope.description: Fields common to every statement type. Each statement schema adds `statementType`, the allowed consent purpose and its own `body`.

schema.description: Schema identifier and version. Minor versions only add optional fields; a major version may change meaning.

dataAsOf.description: The latest point in time the data reflects (the operator's data cut-off), not when the statement was generated.

extensions.description: Operator-specific fields. A TIU MAY ignore them; no core decision field may depend on them.

signature.description: Detached JWS (RFC 7515, compact serialization with an empty payload) over the canonical JSON (RFC 8785) of the statement without this field, signed with the TIP's certified key.

tipId.description: The operator's identifier in the ecosystem registry.

certifiedSchemaVersions.description: Schema versions this TIP is certified for.

purposeCode.description: The ecosystem's purpose code. Each statement type allows only its own purposes.

dpvPurpose.description: The same purpose in the W3C Data Privacy Vocabulary, as GSMA CAMARA uses it.

frequency.description: For PERIODIC consents: the most often the TIU may fetch, as an ISO 8601 duration.

consentExpiry.description: For PERIODIC consents: the last moment a fetch is allowed (typically the loan's maturity).

dataLife.description: How long the TIU may keep the statement after receiving it (ISO 8601 duration); it must delete it afterwards.

linkRef.description: Opaque reference created when the customer linked this number to the consent manager by OTP. Never the MSISDN.

msisdnMasked.description: The number with all but the last 4 digits masked, for display only.

numberStatus.description: ACTIVE: in service. SUSPENDED: outgoing or all service barred (e.g. for non-payment or by request). DISCONNECTED: terminated, not yet reassigned. PORTED_OUT: moved to another operator.

notApplicable.description: The block doesn't apply to this subscriber (e.g. invoices for a prepaid number).

notAvailable.description: The block applies, but the TIP can't provide it. Not the same as zero.

amountInr.description: An amount in Indian rupees, tax included, to the paisa.

dataBand.description: Mobile data used in a month.

voiceBand.description: Voice minutes (outgoing plus incoming) in a month. Never counterparties or call counts per contact.

recency.description: How recently an event last happened, relative to `dataAsOf`. Bands, not timestamps: the decision needs only recent or not, and bands are identical across operators. NEVER: not since the subscriber's activation.

dpdBucket.description: Days past the due date of the oldest unpaid amount.

collectionStage.description: The operator's debt-collection stage for unpaid postpaid charges, in escalating order. REMINDER: payment reminders only. DUNNING: formal overdue notices. OUTGOING_BARRED: outgoing service barred. SUSPENDED: all service barred. DISCONNECTED: terminated for non-payment. EXTERNAL_AGENCY: debt assigned to a collection agency. WRITTEN_OFF: the operator wrote the debt off.

invoice.description: One postpaid invoice (TM Forum TMF678 CustomerBill) with how it was settled (TMF670 Payment). Amounts include taxes.

paidInFullOn.description: The date the invoice was fully paid; absent while any amount is unpaid.

status.description: PAID_ON_TIME: paid in full by the due date. PAID_LATE: paid in full after it. PARTIALLY_PAID / UNPAID: an amount is still due. DISPUTED: under a billing dispute raised by the customer, and not counted as overdue. WAIVED: cancelled by the operator.

daysPastDue.description: Days between the due date and full payment, or `dataAsOf` while unpaid; 0 when paid on time, disputed or waived.

paymentChannel.description: How a recharge or bill was paid. AUTOPAY: a standing mandate (UPI AutoPay, e-NACH, card standing instruction).

channelMix.description: Share of the amount paid through each channel over the window. The shares add up to 1 (a rounding tolerance of 0.01 is allowed). Never the payer's identity, instrument or account.
